title: One-Year Results of Simultaneous Topography-Guided Photorefractive Keratectomy and Corneal Collagen Cross-Linking in Keratoconus Utilizing a Modern Ablation Software

license.statement: CC BY, version not stated (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License; no licence URL in the XML)

groups.description: Simultaneous topography-guided PRK (mechanical epithelial removal, Nidek Quest Custom Ablation Transition Zone profile, maximum ablation depth 58 µm, 0.02% mitomycin C for 30 s) immediately followed by standard epithelium-off CXL (0.1% riboflavin 5-phosphate with 20% dextran T500 for 20 min, 370 nm UVA 3 mW/cm2 for 30 min) for grade 1-2 keratoconus (Amsler-Krumeich), 20 eyes of 14 patients aged 18-29 years, prospective nonrandomized, Cairo 2012-2013. Cross-linking combined with a refractive ablation in the same treatment (protocol context 'other'); no cataract surgery.

exclusions.what: Decimal acuity means in the Results text
exclusions.reason: decimal acuity is not admissible; the logMAR series of Table 1 is used

exclusions.what: Gain or loss of lines of CDVA (text, Figure 3) and efficacy and safety indices
exclusions.reason: lines gained and ratios of decimal means are not admissible

notes: UDVA, Kmax and Kmin (Table 1), per-case sphere, cylinder and spherical equivalent (Table 2), cylindrical correction and haze are mentioned here only.
The abstract and Results text print a 12-month SD that differs from Table 1; the Table 1 cells are cited as printed.

series.notes: Mean ± SD of logMAR CDVA (row 'LogMAR CDVA Mean ± SD'; footnote: CDVA = corrected distance visual acuity; Methods: best spectacle corrected visual acuity). The preoperative cell prints the mean without its leading zero. Table 1 prints no decimal row; the Results text reports decimal means separately, each with its own SD.
